scope: Static review and hash/AST parsing only; neither script was executed.

Readback requires one human text from the exact operator in exact room, complete text-filtered page, and full original task equality after exactly one PM mention normalization.
limitations: Native CLI internal transport retry policy is unverified; this proves one wrapper invocation, not transport exactly-once semantics.
Readback verification is still required after the authorized send; this review is not evidence that any message was sent.

No permission to resend on unknown outcome; operator must preserve the marker and inspect actual room state.
